name: NetDebit for Paid Memberships Pro
author: Martin Berndt

sections.description:
NetDebit® is a professional payment solution for merchants in the adult entertainment industry and other high-risk sectors.

This plugin seamlessly integrates the NetDebit interface into Paid Memberships Pro (tested with WordPress 7.1 and Paid Memberships Pro 3.7.2). It is designed to keep the checkout process as simple as possible by removing unnecessary invoice fields and redirecting the user directly to the secure NetDebit payment form.

Key Features:

  • Full integration with the PMPro checkout.

  • Support for one-time payments and recurring subscriptions.

  • Automated webhook processing for payments, recurring subscriptions, chargebacks, and subscription terminations.

  • Automatic deactivation of incompatible trial periods to ensure compliance with terms and conditions.

  • Clean UI: Removes unnecessary form fields for a higher conversion rate.

  • Native checkout for free membership levels: gratis memberships are processed by PMPro itself, without any NetDebit redirect.

  • NetDebit letterhead: while the plugin is active, PMPro’s Business Settings carry the NetDebit company address (Merchant of Record) for the invoice page. Cleared again on deactivation.

  • Users with active chargebacks are automatically blocked from accessing content.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the netdebit-for-pmpro folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install the archive.

  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress under ‘Plugins’.

  3. Go to ‘Settings’ -> ‘NetDebit PMPro’ and enter your NetDebit partner information (PID, SID, Webmaster ID).

  4. Ensure the correct webhook URL is entered in the NetDebit project settings.
sections.faq:
Can I offer free memberships?

Yes. Membership levels without any payment (initial payment 0, no recurring billing, no trial) are processed natively by Paid Memberships Pro: the NetDebit purchase box is not shown, the checkout completes without a redirect and no booking is created at NetDebit. Paid levels keep using the NetDebit checkout as before. Levels with “first month free” (0 start payment plus paid subscription) or setup fees are rejected, as they are not compatible with direct debit.

Do I need a NetDebit partner account?

Yes, an active partner account is mandatory to earn with our payment plugin. Please register at https://www.netdebit-payment.de/webmaster/registration.

Which payments are offered by NetDebit?

NetDebit offers different kinds of Payments, SEPA transfer, Klarna, PrePaid and others.

What happens if a user causes a chargeback?

In case of a chargeback the user account gets blocked from making further payments and the subscription is deactivated. The user sees a message that s/he should contact NetDebit support.
As soon as the situation is resolved, the subscription is restored and the account is unblocked automatically.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Fixed: Version 1.1.0 was distributed with an incomplete file set (the classes BusinessSettings, FreeMembershipCheck and the gateway alias file were missing from the update package), causing a fatal error “Class \”NetDebit\PMPro\Setup\BusinessSettings\” not found” on plugin activation. Version 1.1.1 contains the complete file set. No functional changes.

1.1.0

  • Added: Free membership levels (initial payment 0, no recurring billing, no trial) are processed natively by PMPro: no NetDebit purchase box, no redirect, no 0 booking. Also applies when a stale form or a manual request posts gateway=netdebit for a free level, and when a 100% discount code makes a paid level free.
  • Fixed: Levels whose start payment differs from the recurring rate can no longer create 0 bookings at NetDebit. This now also covers inconsistent levels configured with a billing amount but no cycle, which previously bypassed the setup-fee check and produced a 0 booking.
  • Added: Central FreeMembershipCheck helper used by checkout redirect, frontend assets and the gateway itself, honoring PMPro’s pmpro_is_level_free filter.
  • Added: On activation the plugin fills PMPro’s Business Settings (Settings → Advanced → Business Settings) with the NetDebit letterhead — NetDebit is the merchant of record, so the invoice “Pay to” block shows the NetDebit company address. Deactivating the plugin clears these fields again.

1.0.3

  • Fixed: The booking webhook now answers with the raw body expected by NetDebit (exactly OK=100, Content-Type text/plain) instead of a JSON-encoded REST response. Unknown notification types are no longer acknowledged (OK=90) so NetDebit retries.

1.0.2

  • Fixed: Checkout no longer fails with PMPro’s generic “Unknown error generating account” message when a submission reaches PMPro without the NetDebit gateway field.
  • Added: The gateway class PMProGateway_netdebit is now declared as an alias of the plugin’s gateway, so PMPro’s own order processing redirects to the NetDebit payment page as a fallback (also improves compatibility with custom/older checkout templates).

1.0.1

  • Tested with WordPress 7.1 and Paid Memberships Pro 3.7.2.
  • Fixed: “Translation loading triggered too early” PHP notice on cron requests (settings field labels are now built lazily, after the init hook).

1.0.0

  • Fixed: Frontend requests no longer break when Paid Memberships Pro is deactivated (dependency check moved to plugin activation).
  • Fixed: Automatic self-deactivation now works correctly when the dependency plugin is deactivated.
  • Fixed: Chargeback notice text is no longer double URL-encoded.
  • Added: Trial period / setup fee error message is now shown on the checkout page.
  • Fixed: Users are unblocked again when a settlement settles an open chargeback (automatic restore of membership and account access, as documented in the readme).
  • Cleanup: Removed dead code, unused nonces, unused imports and an unused return-URL parameter.
  • Improved: Webhook concurrency protection now uses an atomic MySQL advisory lock (GET_LOCK) that is released automatically if a request crashes, so retries are never lost.
  • Cleanup: Frontend assets are now only loaded on the checkout page.

0.8.4

  • Fixed more requested issues. Tested with WordPress 7.

0.8.3

  • Fixed more requested issues.

0.8.2

  • Reorganized the upload.

0.8.1

  • Fixed more requested issues.

0.8.0

  • Improved chargeback handling.

0.7.0

  • First stable version for the WordPress.org repository.

  • Security improvements: Nonce verification for checkout and admin actions.

  • Security improvements: Input sanitization and output escaping throughout the plugin.

  • Refactoring: Updated webhook logic to use NetDebit SDK 0.9.2.

  • Compatibility: Tested with WordPress 6.9 and Paid Memberships Pro latest version.
